mechanism_narrative: The current federal funds rate of 0.15% is at a historically low level, compressing discount rates and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 60% of days when FEDFUNDS is below 0.2%, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 7.5%, it signals a weak labor market that suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When labor market growth (PAYEMS) exceeds 135,000 thousand persons and industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0, it indicates a weakening economy with slowing labor demand and supply constraints, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 60% of triggered instances, or interaction effect is not significant (p>0.05) in regression of returns on interaction term.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (indicated by GDP growth above 13,800 billion dollars and CPI above 235.0), monetary policy tightening and inflationary pressures lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 60% of triggered instances, or interaction effect is not significant (p>0.05) in regression of returns on interaction term.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI index exceeds 235.0, it signals persistent inflation that may trigger monetary policy tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The current level of residential investment (RSAFS) at 419,027 million dollars indicates strong housing demand, which is a leading indicator of economic expansion and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in less than 60% of days when RSAFS is above 400,000 million dollars, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1,000 thousand units and unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 7.5%, it indicates a dual stress of weak housing demand and labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 60% of triggered instances, or interaction effect is not significant (p>0.05) in regression of returns on interaction term.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 98.0, it signals a contraction in manufacturing output that suppresses corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
